description: This file defines a repository interface for accessing SmsCampaign entities from the database, providing various query methods including custom JPQL query for active SMS campaigns.

classes.name: SmsCampaignRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for SmsCampaign entity, providing CRUD and custom query methods.

methods.name: findByCampaignType
methods.description: Finds a list of SMS campaigns by campaign type.

methods.name: findByCampaignTypeAndTriggerTypeAndStatus
methods.description: Finds campaigns matching specific campaign type, trigger type, and status.

methods.name: findByTriggerTypeAndStatus
methods.description: Finds campaigns by trigger type and status.

methods.name: findActiveSmsCampaigns
methods.description: Custom query to find active SMS campaigns matching a report pattern, trigger type, and with status 300.
